services.name: Pirate Adventure Aboard the Sea Gypsy X
services.desc: Welcome aboard the island's first and only pirate ship! Duration 90 minutes Description Our 40-foot, custom vessel is designed just for kids! Ideally suited for 2-10 year olds, it’s a stage at sea - a safe, magical place for imagination to take over and memories to be made. From beginning to end, the action is non-stop as we transform your kids into our hearty pirate crew. Every new mate gets a pirate name, face-paint, dress up and learns how to talk like a pirate - all before we leave the shore!
